name: Greenland
hook: The world's largest island: Erik the Red's sales pitch and a Danish territory.

facts.label: world's largest island
facts.statement: Greenland is the world's largest island; in its native language it is called Kalaallit Nunaat.

facts.label: Erik the Red
facts.statement: Erik the Red gave Greenland its appealing name to attract settlers and founded a colony there around 985.

facts.label: Denmark
facts.statement: Greenland is a self-governing territory of Denmark and uses the Danish krone.

facts.label: Iceland
facts.statement: Iceland lies about 200 miles east of Greenland, across the Denmark Strait.

facts.label: Baffin Bay
facts.statement: Baffin Bay lies between Greenland and Canada's Arctic islands, and the Davis Strait separates Greenland from Baffin Island.

facts.label: Matthew Henson
facts.statement: Matthew Henson, the African-American explorer who accompanied Robert Peary, lived in Greenland in the 1890s.

facts.label: Leif Ericson
facts.statement: Leif Ericson, Erik the Red's son, brought Christianity to Greenland and sailed to Vinland around 1000.
